[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220022/b7be152a0b629880c474dd77368ddd1618c79ebc.png[/img]
[b]This DLC also includes a new SYSTEM THEME and new in game PLAY SKINs![/b]

[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220022/896512666e3eb1a801c0a683febf7c06453ca705.png[/img]
[b]Select the HARDCORE TANO*C Collaboration PATH in the PATH SELECT menu, play and get special rewards![/b]


Selecting the HARDCORE TANO*C SPECIAL Collaboration PATH in the PATH SELECT menu will grant you access to the PATH, which will allow you to unlock rewards as you play!


Playing songs from the HARDCORE TANO*C SPECIAL COLLABORATION Pack DLC will add a bonus to what you earn!

Progress to STEP 20 of this PATH and complete the VMission to unlock a new song.
The mission can be challenged freely, at any time by selecting STEP 20 in the escape menu.

※Songs available for Trial play will have a TRIAL mark on it's jacket in Free Play/Mash Up mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220022/5f55513de0df4a5f925b05c5b71dcc5a0c8e15bb.png[/img]

The Hit Chart icon has also been added to MASH UP Mode, making it easy to find our most popular Mashup Tracks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220022/9de2f4bf2f32fc3dab605cd7de5492d7af5ae2d6.png[/img]

We've added a feature that allows your audio offset to be automatically calibrated!

You can perform automatic calibration by going to the AUDIO OFFSET ADJUSTMENT option inside of Advanced settings, in the GAMEPLAY tab.

The SINGLE LANE option has been added. This is intended for practice. Turning this setting on will force the lanes to always be converged into a single lane during play.
This can be set in the Advanced Settings screen, under the Gameplay tab.

[list]
[*] Score/Rate/Clear information will not be saved.
[*] Your Ability Point total cannot increase.
[*] You cannot progress in your active VIRTUAL PATH.
[/list]

※ This option does not work in GHOST BATTLE Mode.

notes.title: Announcement regarding the VIRTUAL PATH System
notes.content:
First off, we would like to thank everyone for supporting MASH VP! Re:VISION!

Thanks to all of the support we've received, we've been officially been able to reach the half anniversary of the release of MASH VP! Re:VISION!
From the bottom of our hearts, we want to thank everyone who has been supporting us for the past 6 months.

All of at AXTORM used to be avid music gamers; we've been lucky enough to have been given the chance to develop a game of our own. It is our goal to provide our users with a new, never before seen experience in the form of a rhythm game. There have been a lot of challenges along the way, but you, all of our users, have been our driving force.

Due to feedback we have received from all of you, we have made the decision to remove the limited time element of the VIRTUAL PATH system. VIRTUAL PATH's, both already released and those to come, will be permanent content additions to the game. We hope that this gives all of you the chance to enjoy the VIRTUAL PATH system with more freedom and comfort.

However, we also understand the weight of making such a decision at this time. With the conflict PATH slated to end in just a few days, we understand that some of you may be inconvenienced by this change. We sincerely apologize for any burden we caused.

This was not a decision that was made lightly. We understand the gravity that comes with a decision like this, and the entire development team handled this change very seriously. However, we apologize for not providing notice of this further in advance.

We want to thank all of our players that enjoyed the VIRTUAL PATH content under the impression that it was going to be limited time content; and we sincerely apologize for giving that false impression. From now on, we will do even more to ensure that we are more careful in terms of guidance and management of in-game content.

We will continue to do everything we can to work together with all of you, our users, to make MASH VP! Re:VISION a title that will be loved for many years to come.

As always, we appreciate your continued support!

notes.title: [Official Release] MASH VP! Re:VISION ver1.0.0 has been released!
notes.content:
MASH VP! Re:VISION has finally left Early Access!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220022/4df02c2553ac9225bd7798f4cd334179d06ea749.png[/img]

We greatly appreciate the feedback we received during Early Access.

Just like our game's title, we aim to Re:VISE the music game experience.

[h1]CHRONO CIRCLE PATH Now Available![/h1]

The second VIRTUAL PATH, the CHRONO CIRCLE Path, has started!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220022/5943a8149a35aebcad3e3700b63cce86d75ae5cc.png[/img]

Event Period: 
3/22/2025 (after official release) -> 5/21/2025 05:00AM (JST)
During this event, you can select the CHRONO CIRCLE Path in the Path Select screen. A clock will appear in game; which can be progressed by playing songs.

Progressing the clock to certain times will unlock a variety of rewards,
such as songs from CHRONO CIRCLE, as well as other CHRONO CIRCLE inspired customization items.

There is a limit to how much the clock can be progressed in a single day.
Each day, the clock can be progressed for a total of 1 hour; completing all 12 hours of the event will take 12 days of play.
If you do not progress the clock by one hour on any given day, you will be able to progress the clock by an additional hour.
(for example; if you progress the clock to 0:30 on the first day, while your limit is set to 1:00, your limit on the following day will be set to 2:00)
The limit on the clock will be refreshed every day at 5AM JST.
Play every day to get all the rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220022/111191db27bc8e6d9dba814b5d2d0a2fa4b440f4.png[/img]

Event Period:
3/22/2025 (after official release) -> 4/30/2025 05:00AM (JST)

During this limited time event, 2 special gauges,
RED and BLUE, will appear in game.
Playing songs will net you points; the better you do, the more points you get.
Getting each gauge above certain point landmarks will unlock various items,
ranging from Mashup Tracks to customization items.
You can view your progress in the event by pressing the Escape key.
Filling up both of the gauges to max will allow you to challenge the VIRTUAL MISSION!
Clearing the VIRTUAL MISSION will unlock a special theme skin in game!
(if you are unable to clear the VIRTUAL MISSION during the conflict PATH period, filling up both gauges to max
will unlock the conflict theme skin when the conflict PATH ends.)
We also will be adding a special reward that will be given to everyone that attempts the VIRTUAL MISSION.
This reward will be added at a later time.
We will announce the details of this reward in the near future! 

-----------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Rank Match Season 1 Now Open![/h1]

The first Rank Match Season has started!

Rank Match is a mode where you can challenge ghosts made from players close to your skill level. Beat increasingly stronger opponents and aim for the top!
Your RP will change depending on the outcome of each match, and reaching certain RP landmarks will advance you higher Ranks and Tiers.
※In Rank Match, you can play songs you have not unlocked up to 5 times per week.
※If you disconnect from a Rank Match midway, it will count as a loss and your RP will decrease.

Changes from the Preseason
Each player's Tier and Rank have been reset due to a change in how matchmaking is done.

Players that end Season 1 as BRONZE rank or higher
will receive a special Ghostboard Customization Item according to their rank.

There is also an added RP bonus for win streaks above 3 or more: 
3-4 win streak -> 1.5x multiplier
5 win streak -> 2.0x multiplier

Your opponents will be selected via Ability Point totals, which will change for each Tier and Rank.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Navigator Character Update![/h1]

In addition to adding animations to the Navigator Characters in game, a large number of new voicelines have been added.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]My Page[/h1]

The My Page menu has been added. You can visit the My Page menu via the Navigation Menu; displayed after pressing the Escape key.
The My Page menu contains the following features:
・ Play Data Display
・Ghostboard Customization
・System/Character Theme selection

-----------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]New Features and Improvements[/h1]

・The System BGM has been revamped.・The Quick Retry feature has been added. Holding down the F5 key in game will restart the song being played from the beginning.
・The Mashup Button has been added to Free Play mode. While highlighting any song in Free Play Mode, pressing the F2 key or pressing the Mashup button will navigate to Mashup Mode with the same song selected.
・Added a Background Skin option to the Advanced Settings menu. You can change the background displayed in game using this option. Selecting AUTO will display preselected backgrounds that fit each song in game. We recommend playing on AUTO to experience each background that is available!
・Removed the unlock condition on each Mashup track that required the user to play each single song in Free Play Mode. 
・Several other UI/animation brushups.

[h1]Audio Engine Change[/h1]
The audio engine for the game has been changed from Unity Audio to FMOD. 
ASIO support has also been added. The game can now be played in low-latency mode.
Added the "DRIVER" option to the System Setting's "SOUND" menu. Here you can set the sound driver used during audio playback. If a driver using ASIO is selected, you can lower the audio latency of the game overall.
※Because of the audio engine change, the timing in game may be different than before. It is recommend that you go back to the Advanced Settings menu and re-adjust the "AUDIO OFFSET ADJUSTMENT" and "VISUAL OFFSET ADJUSTMENT" options if you feel like the sync significantly changed for you.

[h1]New Features and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved several in-game UI parts. 
[*] Added the "Reduce Shift Effect" option to the Display Option menu in the Advanced Settings screen. This allows you to reduce the amount of camera movement induced by shift notes in game. NOTE: This is currently ON by default. If you wish to reset to how it originally was, set this to OFF.
[*] Improved the quality of the READY, CLEAR, and FULL COMBO animations that appear at the end of a song.
[*] Added more voicelines that are played on the Results screen.
[/list]
